_help: Act 3, the temple on the desert road (event temple_visit): the Egyptologist asks for a day. Stay: the clue act3_road/temple, temple_studied, race_step 4 (the delay). Leave: race_step 3. If Hassan is misdirecting (hassan_misdirected) and no other scholar is along, he says there's nothing; looking anyway finds the clue and catches him (hassan_caught). End ids end_stay / end_leave. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act3.py.

hassan_lies.speaker: hassan
hassan_lies.line: As I said. Graffiti, and later work over that. There is nothing here for us. We should not lose the day.

choices.label: Look for yourself
choices.line: Humour me. I'll have a look anyway.

look.speaker: player
look.line: Under the sand by the door, a procession is carved into the wall, as clear as the day it was cut. Hassan doesn't look surprised.

caught.speaker: hassan
caught.line: ...I wanted to spare you. Some roads are better not taken. Forgive an old man his caution.

ask_eleanor.speaker: eleanor
ask_eleanor.line: Look at this. A procession, and it's going somewhere. Give me today and I'll tell you where.

ask_pembroke.speaker: pembroke
ask_pembroke.line: These reliefs must be recorded. A day, properly, and we'll know what we're riding into.

ask_hassan.speaker: hassan
ask_hassan.line: The three gods, carrying their keys. I would like a day with these walls. They are speaking about the place we are going.

ask_none.speaker: player
ask_none.line: Carvings everywhere. Without someone to read them, they're just pictures.

decide.speaker: player
decide.line: A day here, or keep our lead?

choices.label: Stay and study
choices.line: Take the day. Tell me what it says.

choices.label: Leave at once
choices.line: Sketch what you can in an hour. Then we ride.

stay_eleanor.speaker: eleanor
stay_eleanor.line: Anubis, Horus, Ra. The same order as the old accounts. And this, the bound man with the eye... he walks wherever the eye goes.

stay_pembroke.speaker: pembroke
stay_pembroke.line: Three gods and a guardian in bronze bands. Remarkably consistent iconography. I'll want to compare it with the site itself.

stay_hassan.speaker: hassan
stay_hassan.line: 'He goes where the eye goes.' Remember that line, whatever else you forget.

stay_none.speaker: player
stay_none.line: Three gods in a row, and a man in chains holding an eye. It means something. I just don't know what.

leave.speaker: player
leave.line: We leave the temple to the sand and keep our lead.
